lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zr₂Ag₆Sn₂ (reduced formula ZrAg₃Sn) crystallizes in the hexagonal system with space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), containing 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis gives Ag centers a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors (2 Ag, 2 Sn, 8 Zr) over distances of 2.90–3.31 Å, while Sn and Zr each show 16 neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing between 12-vertex Ag polyhedra and between 12-vertex Ag and 16-vertex Sn or Zr polyhedra.
